en.title: AWS Certified Data Engineer, Associate (DEA-C01) Complete Course
en.description: Comprehensive preparation for the AWS Certified Data Engineer, Associate (DEA-C01) exam covering data ingestion and transformation, data store management, data operations and support, and data security and governance, with architecture diagrams, real AWS customer case studies, worked pipeline examples, and exam-style practice questions including multiple-response drills.

pt.title: AWS Certified Data Engineer, Associate (DEA-C01) Curso Completo
pt.description: Curso completo para o exame AWS Certified Data Engineer, Associate (DEA-C01): ingestão e transformação de dados na AWS (Kinesis, MSK, Glue, EMR), armazenamento e governança (S3, Lake Formation, IAM), orquestration (Step Functions, MWAA), análise e servação (Athena, Redshift, QuickSight), segurança, resiliência e otimização de custos, com arquiteturas, casos reais, exemplos de SQL/PySpark e questões de prática.

es.title: AWS Certified Data Engineer, Associate (DEA-C01) Curso Completo
es.description: Curso completo para el examen AWS Certified Data Engineer, Associate (DEA-C01): ingesta y transformación de datos en AWS (Kinesis, MSK, Glue, EMR), almacenamiento y gobernanza (S3, Lake Formation, IAM), orquestación (Step Functions, MWAA), análisis y servicio de datos (Athena, Redshift, QuickSight), seguridad, resiliencia y optimización de costos, con arquitecturas, casos reales, ejemplos de SQL/PySpark y preguntas de práctica.
